claude.result:
Perfect! I've successfully added weekly subscription support to subtrack. Here's what was implemented:

## Changes Made

### Core Functionality (src/cycles.js)
- Added `CYCLE.WEEK: 'weekly'` to support weekly billing cycles
- Updated `MONTHS_PER_CHARGE` to calculate monthly cost for weekly plans: `price × 52 ÷ 12`
- Enhanced `nextCharge()` to calculate weekly charges by adding 7 days repeatedly from the start date

### CLI Support (bin/subtrack.js)
- Updated usage to show `--every month|year|week` option
- Added week/weekly mappings to the EVERY object
- Updated error message to mention week as valid option
- Added SHARE_PER_MONTH calculation for weekly cycles

### Bug Fix (src/renewals.js)
- Fixed the `upcoming()` function to sort renewals by `date` instead of `when` (short label)
- This ensures "soonest first" ordering works correctly across month boundaries

### Tests
- Added test for weekly plan monthly cost calculation
- Added test for weekly plan charge scheduling (every 7 days)
- Added CLI test for adding weekly plans
- Added CLI test for weekly plan renewals

## How It Works

```bash
subtrack add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week
```

- A €59.90 weekly subscription will be listed with a monthly cost of €259.56 (59.90 × 52 ÷ 12)
- It charges every 7 days from the `--since` date (defaults to today)
- `subtrack renewals` lists weekly renewals alongside monthly and yearly ones
- All 38 tests pass ✓
